_note: ROADMAP DATA MODEL (server phase 0.8+). Local stub only: 'List on Marketplace' from the Satchel writes to user://ugc/listings.json.

marketplace.merchant_outbox: server-side store of items to deliver; listing pulls from it (like SL Merchant Outbox)
marketplace.delivery: on purchase, a copy is put into the buyer's Satchel 'Received Items' folder; redelivery from purchase history
marketplace.search: full-text over title/keywords + filters (category, price, rating, mature gate)

exchange.name: Aethel Exchange (AEX)
exchange.matching: price-time priority order book; market orders take best available rate
exchange.compliance: REAL-MONEY EXCHANGE REQUIRES LEGAL/COMPLIANCE REVIEW BEFORE LAUNCH: money-transmitter licensing (US FinCEN MSB + state licenses), KYC/AML, sanctions screening, tax reporting, app-store payment rules. Until then AEC stays a closed in-game currency (earn/buy only, no cash-out).
